snippet.title: Eye of Syn Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Tower Defense meets Eldritch Horror. Summon and combine demons to battle against zombie hordes in Eye of Syn, a lane based tower defense game where you must protect two dimensions at once. Uncover dark secrets and powerful demon synergies as you try to save Earth from an eldritch apocalypse.

Official Release Date: November 5th, 2026. 
Demo out now! 

WISHLIST ON STEAM https://store.steampowered.com/app/4305730/Eye_of_Syn/ 

Developed by Globin Games, an indie studio based in Boston, Massachusetts.
